scoring_justification: The paper does not tabulate exact ΔS or RC numbers; only curves are shown. Therefore the strongest feasible check verifies structural features: sign, peak magnitude, and peak composition, which capture the model's essential predictions.

outputs.description: Dimensionless entropy change ΔS̄ vs. reduced temperature t for Ni₂Mn₀.₇₄Cu₀.₂₆Ga at H̄=0.005. Must show a negative ΔS̄ with a large peak in the transition region.
Dimensionless entropy change ΔS̄ vs. reduced temperature t for Ni₂Mn₁.₃₇In₀.₆₃ at H̄=0.005. Must show a positive ΔS̄ (inverse MCE) in the transition region.
Refrigerant capacity RC̄ vs. composition x for Ni₂Mn₁₋ₓCuₓGa at H̄=0.005. Must peak near x=0.25.
Refrigerant capacity RC̄ vs. composition x for Ni₂Mn₁₊ₓIn₁₋ₓ at H̄=0.005. Must peak near x=0.375.

output_contract.notes: The task verifies the sign and composition dependence of the magnetocaloric effect (normal for CuGa, inverse for In) and the refrigerant capacity trends predicted by the Landau free energy model. Only the core model predictions are required; the later Maxwell relation analysis (Section 6 of the paper) is excluded.
